LanguageData.MW_PA_AssignLoadersDesc: Choose colonists or mechs who keep this mount loaded. A loader reloads it whenever its ammo drops to the marker on the ammo bar, as part of their hauling work. A mount can have several loaders, and a loader can serve several mounts.
LanguageData.MW_PA_AmmoGizmoTip: {0} / {1} rounds.\n\nLoaders reload this mount when its ammo drops to {2}% or less. Drag the marker to change that. Once it's empty, its gunner reloads a manned mount, and anyone doing hauling work reloads an automated one.
LanguageData.MW_PA_GunnerNoAmmo: {PAWN_labelShort} has no {AMMO} to reload {MOUNT_label}. Build an ammo station or keep ammo packs in storage.
